# `inventory_daily`

**Layer:** **synthetic** — generated by `scripts/synth/generate.py` for demonstration. Every answer that reads this table must say so (`V2-SYN-4`). Dates span 2016-09-01 to 2018-10-31.

Daily stock position per category.

**Grain:** category x day.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | Day. | date |
| `category` | Real category name. | text |
| `stock_on_hand` | Units in stock at end of day. | units |
| `units_sold` | Units sold that day (synthetic demand, capped by stock). | units |
| `stockout_flag` | 1 when stock is zero at end of day. | 0/1 |

## Join keys

- `inventory_daily.category = products.product_category_name`

## Caveats

- `units_sold` is synthetic demand and will not equal real `order_items` counts.
- Demand responds to the category list-price index with elasticity −1.5 (the answer key).
